title: First Light Fishing Adventures
specs: Fishing for salmon and halibut near shore and offshore 3-4 miles
Boat is a 26' Northwest Aluminum Craft with enclosed head and diesel heater
All members onboard must have a valid B.C. tidal water sportfishing license, purchased online and printed
Salmon conservation stamp required on license if retaining salmon
Children welcome; contact ahead to ensure suitable lifejacket
Pricing based on group of up to four guests; up to five guests allowed with additional $100 flat fee

options.name: Custom Trip
options.detail: Hourly fishing charter with minimum 4 hour booking

variants.label: Hourly fishing charter with minimum 4 hour booking

includes: Fish cleaning and packaging in provided fish bag
blurb: Guests fish for salmon and halibut near Sooke, BC, with trips ranging from close to shore to offshore 3-4 miles. The boat is a 26' Northwest Aluminum Craft designed for comfort and safety. Trips include fishing with a guide and fish cleaning and packaging after the trip.
extraNote: Full payment required immediately upon returning to dock; cash, E-Transfer, and major credit cards accepted; no cheques or debit cards · If weather conditions are unsafe, trip will be rescheduled; trips proceed in rain or chill · Moored full-time at Jock's Dock in Sooke, adjacent to the Prestige Resort; pickup can be arranged at the public dock in front of the Prestige Oceanfront Resort.
